newsitem.title: INDIA: James Capel B & K downgrades Indian cement sector.
newsitem.headline: James Capel B & K downgrades Indian cement sector.

text.p: Securities firm James Capel B & K said on Wednesday it downgraded the Indian cement sector to "neutral" from "overweight."

In a sectoral update, analyst Namita Manel attributed the change in recommendation to a "deceleration in economic activity, continuing softening of real estate prices in the big cities and almost flat growth in volumes and margins of most major (cement) players."
James Capel said it recommended a "hold" on cement majors such as Associated Cement Companies, Madras Cements and Gujarat Ambuja Cements.
James Capel maintained its "buy" recommendation on India Cements Ltd, calling it an underpriced stock.
